$comment: Pins Go (shared.ValidateXMLInput) and TypeScript (validateXmlInput) to one verdict on every XML input a converter is handed. The policy is OWASP's second XXE option: an inert internal DTD is accepted, and the gate refuses inline entity declarations, SYSTEM/PUBLIC external identifiers, and any input naming a DOCTYPE whose prologue cannot be parsed. `error` is the gate's exact message before a converter prefixes its name; an empty string means the input must be accepted. `maxSize`, when present, is passed as the explicit size limit. When leadingCommentBytes > 0 the suite prepends a comment of that many filler bytes before `xml`.

cases.name: plain document
cases.why: nothing in the prologue

cases.name: harmless DOCTYPE with no subset
cases.why: a DOCTYPE that declares nothing and references nothing can neither expand nor fetch

cases.name: inert internal subset (real Burp Suite export shape)
cases.xml: <?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE issues [<!ELEMENT issues (issue*)><!ATTLIST issues burpVersion CDATA "">]><issues/>
cases.why: ELEMENT and ATTLIST declare structure only; refusing them refuses a published tool's own output

cases.name: inline entity declaration
cases.error: XML input contains entity declarations which are not supported (potential entity expansion attack)
cases.why: the billion-laughs vector

cases.name: entity hidden behind a quoted ]> in the subset
cases.error: XML input contains entity declarations which are not supported (potential entity expansion attack)
cases.why: a substring search for the first ]> ends the subset inside a literal

cases.name: entity hidden after a processing instruction carrying a quote
cases.error: XML input contains entity declarations which are not supported (potential entity expansion attack)
cases.why: a PI is legal in the internal subset and its quote is not a literal; entity declarations are reported ahead of external identifiers

cases.name: external DTD reference by SYSTEM identifier
cases.error: XML input references an external DTD or entity which is not supported (potential external entity attack)
cases.why: the XXE and SSRF vector needs no inline entity of its own

cases.name: external DTD reference by PUBLIC identifier
cases.error: XML input references an external DTD or entity which is not supported (potential external entity attack)
cases.why: a PUBLIC identifier carries a system literal a resolver may fetch

cases.name: external identifier inside the subset
cases.error: XML input references an external DTD or entity which is not supported (potential external entity attack)
cases.why: any external reference in the subset counts, whichever declaration carries it

cases.name: entity beyond the old 4 KB window
cases.error: XML input contains entity declarations which are not supported (potential entity expansion attack)
cases.why: the prologue is walked to the root element, not scanned in a fixed window

cases.name: a DOCTYPE with unparseable declarations is refused, not accepted
cases.error: XML input has a DOCTYPE whose declarations could not be fully parsed, so it cannot be checked
cases.why: an unparsed prologue gives a lower bound, not an answer

cases.name: an unterminated processing instruction in the subset is refused
cases.error: XML input has a DOCTYPE whose declarations could not be fully parsed, so it cannot be checked
cases.why: the PI runs to the end of input, so the scan fails closed

cases.name: a non-XML buffer is left to the parser, not refused here
cases.why: an unparseable input that names no DOCTYPE is the parser's to report

cases.name: UTF-8 BOM before an entity declaration
cases.error: XML input contains entity declarations which are not supported (potential entity expansion attack)
cases.why: one leading BOM is an encoding signature and must not hide the DTD

cases.name: UTF-8 BOM before an external DTD reference
cases.error: XML input references an external DTD or entity which is not supported (potential external entity attack)
cases.why: the BOM bypass aimed at the XXE vector

cases.name: UTF-8 BOM before a benign document
cases.why: tools on Windows routinely write a BOM

cases.name: a second BOM hides the DOCTYPE from the scanner
cases.error: XML input has a DOCTYPE whose declarations could not be fully parsed, so it cannot be checked
cases.why: the scanner stops at the second BOM, and the DOCTYPE token anywhere in the input refuses it

cases.name: leading junk hides the DOCTYPE from the scanner
cases.error: XML input has a DOCTYPE whose declarations could not be fully parsed, so it cannot be checked
cases.why: the DOCTYPE token is matched in any case

cases.name: an unparseable prologue that names no DOCTYPE is left to the parser
cases.why: no DOCTYPE token, so nothing for this gate to refuse

cases.name: over an explicit size limit
cases.error: XML input exceeds maximum allowed size of 3 bytes (7 bytes provided)
cases.why: the size check runs first

cases.name: size is measured in UTF-8 bytes
cases.error: XML input exceeds maximum allowed size of 8 bytes (9 bytes provided)
cases.why: Go measures bytes; a string length would count 8 and accept
